correctness.rationale: Summing even modulations (p=N/2 channels) forces frame-operator couplings only between antipodal j,j+p, with Hermitian blocks diag 3/2 and off-diagonal σ_j/2, yielding the exact 3/2±|σ_j|/2 spectrum. Tight iff σ_j=z_j+z_(j−s)+z_(j−2s)=0, where |z_j|=1 and z_(j+p)=conj z_j. Along an s-cycle of length ell the zero-sum recurrence enforces w_t=w_(t−3), so 3|ell and unit triples must be equilateral. If ell even, antipodal offset is (ell/2)s, a multiple of three steps, forcing z=conj z, impossible for three real unit numbers summing to zero. For ell odd multiple three, addition p pairs the d=N/ell cosets and allows exactly two orientations with arbitrary phase u per pair. A q-phase window exists iff 3|q, with q choices of u and 2 orientations for each d/2 coset pair, plus q^p independent antipodal lifts: q^p(2q)^(d/2). Independently exhaustively enumerated q-phase triples at (N,s,q)=(6,2,3),(6,2,6),(6,1,3),(10,2,3), obtaining 162,2592,0,0 respectively; infinite classification rests on the recurrence proof.
